title: hakea glabella subsp. prostrata
intro: Hakea glabella subsp. prostrata, commonly known as a prostrate Hakea, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Proteaceae. It is a low-growing, spreading shrub native to Western Australia, valued for its ornamental and medicinal properties. The plant is rich in antioxidants and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and fever, due to its therapeutic actions such as antipyretic and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Hakea glabella subsp. prostrata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities.
